announcements.headline: EQS-News: IBU-tec steps up international customer contacts at Battery Trade Shows in the USA and India
announcements.insight: IBU Tec Advanced Materials AG expands international customer contacts at trade shows. This follows recent progress in building LFP production capacity and securing permits.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: IBU-tec receives important permit from the State Administrative Office – another milestone in the construction of Europe's largest LFP production plant
announcements.insight: IBU Tec Advanced Materials AG secured a critical permit for its LFP plant construction. This follows scheduled progress updates from July and confirms the project remains on track as stated in August.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: IBU-tec fully on track in the first half of 2026 / Focus on capacity build-up for large LFP plant
announcements.insight: IBU-tec Advanced Materials AG reports full progress in H1 2026, following a major battery services order in June and construction updates in July.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: IBU-tec with Further Scheduled Construction Progress in Building LFP Production Facility in Bitterfeld
announcements.insight: IBU Tec Advanced Materials AG reports construction progress at its Bitterfeld facility. This follows a June 2026 battery services order, indicating operational execution.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: IBU-tec receives major order in the battery services segment
announcements.insight: IBU Tec Advanced Materials AG receives a major order in its battery services segment. This contract represents a commercial development for the company.
